title: SolutionViewer: the space key starts and immediately stops again on macOS
author: Claude-JG
description: On macOS the space key does not start/stop as promised, it stops again at once; on Windows it works. Wanted: space switches between (Continuous run and start) and (stop and Static)
releaseNotes: the space key of the SolutionViewer starts in Continuous run and stops in Static, also on macOS, where the focused Run button toggled a second time. revision2026c step RG6.18
